messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "increase in gout attacks"
set: ["increase in gout attacks", "gout attacks", "gout attacks once they occur", "gout attacks when first starting tablets", "gout", "panic attacks in adults", "angina attacks", "other gout medications", "monitor for gout", "panic attacks", "increase in blood sugar (glucose) levels", "gout or high uric acid levels", "sudden, unexpected attacks of extreme fear and worry about these attacks", "increase attention", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may increase suicidal thoughts in young people"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
